title: Golf ball lands on Frederick Wolfe's grave
place_text: Fort Knox golf course cemetery, Kentucky

tellings.quote: And it says Frederick Wolfe. >> [sighs] >> German soldier died

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former senior CIA officer, says that in 1976, playing golf at Fort Knox in Kentucky, his ball landed in a cemetery on the course, on a gravestone reading "Frederick Wolfe. German soldier died". He tells it as something he lived through, in an episode where he describes himself as a kind of time traveller, so the coincidence carries weight for him.
